title: Can I MASTER Setup Chess?
summary: chess.com Setup Chess vs online humans: both players spend exactly 39 points of material to build a position anywhere on their first three ranks (king included), placing pieces alternately and visibly, then play normal chess. Goal: win five games. Game 1 he tries viewers' 'spam pawns' idea (two layers of pawns + bishops + one rook), game 2 'spam bishops' (best value for 3 points), later a triple stack of rooks. He wins the fifth game in game 6.
rules: Board starts empty. Each player has a 39-point budget: P=1, N=3, B=3, R=5, Q=9; the king is free and must be placed.
Pieces can only be placed on your own first three ranks; pawns cannot be placed on the back rank (1:00 'it won't even allow me to put pawns on the back rank').
Placement alternates between players and is visible to both; you may use any combination (e.g. 16 pawns + bishops + rook = 39).
After both budgets are spent the game is played with normal chess rules (no castling, inferred), White moves first.
win_condition: Checkmate. Series goal: 5 wins (5th win in game 6).
